title: Adding an external agent writes merged settings back to one scope, leaking values between `settings.json` and `settings.local.json`

verdict.rationale: The evidence shows external_agents persistence was added as a review fix to make sure the setting got written, but nothing indicates anyone chose to write the whole merged settings object into one scope. The load-merged, save-whole pattern was simply carried over, and the issue itself says the repo already knew this hazard.
